entities.name: Precinct Five
entities.description: The intellectual core of the Tenth District of Ravnica City, renowned for universities, libraries and secret labs.

entities.name: Tenth District
entities.description: A district of Ravnica City containing Precinct Five.

entities.name: Zonot Seven
entities.description: The Simic Combine's sinkhole habitat and seat, the only zonot inside Ravnica City; it holds Zameck.

entities.name: Zameck
entities.description: The Simic guildhall within Zonot Seven.

entities.name: Simic Combine
entities.description: The guild of biological research whose seat is Zonot Seven.

entities.name: Izzet League
entities.description: The guild that runs labs and workshops and built the Blistercoils.

entities.name: House Dimir
entities.description: The secretive guild whose operatives secretly control the Ismeri Library.

entities.name: Azorius Senate
entities.description: The guild of law, which quickly hushes violent crime in the precinct.

entities.name: Ismeri Library
entities.description: One of Ravnica's greatest libraries, used by House Dimir as a covert hub for coded messages.

entities.name: Prism University
entities.description: A crystal-walled university teaching general magical theory, considered a rival of Strixhaven University after the opening of the Omenpaths.

entities.name: Strixhaven University
entities.description: A university on Arcavios that Prism University rivals.

entities.name: The Blistercoils
entities.description: Enormous Izzet waterwheels near Zonot Seven's north end, and the nearby neighborhood of labs.

entities.name: Hightower
entities.description: A western neighborhood full of schools and academies.

entities.name: Thinktank Enclave
entities.description: An independent guildless city built on a raft of Golgari garbage, formerly run by the Izzet.

entities.name: Hendrik Azmerak
entities.description: Grand Arbiter who governs the Thinktank Enclave.

entities.name: Zegana
entities.description: Simic Prime Speaker whom visitors may meet in Zameck.

events.summary: An emergency led to the Thinktank Enclave's temporary and then permanent sovereignty from the Izzet.
events.quote: Formerly run by the Izzet, an emergency prompted the temporary and subsequently permanent sovereignty of this city.

events.summary: With the opening of the Omenpaths in 4562 AR, Prism University came to be considered a rival of Strixhaven University.
events.quote: it is considered a rival of Strixhaven University
